methodology: Dated public commitments, documented activities and limited delivery reports are distinct. An evidence-only record has no invented earlier promise. Status is tied to its evidence snapshot and shared agency responsibility is explicit. Historical activity is not a live November performance measurement. Allocations, attendance, sales orders and unrelated programme ratios are not completion percentages. Additional research may extend this initial pass.

sh-mohmed-puzi-sh-ali.scope: Initial bounded source pass, up to two attributable milestones per person. Additional commitments are not researched to completion.
sh-mohmed-puzi-sh-ali.milestone_research_status: no_new_milestone_selected_in_reviewed_sources; not a claim that no public commitments exist
sh-mohmed-puzi-sh-ali.unselected_commitments: Questions, policy suggestions, other ministers’ promises, event attendance and unrelated namesakes were not converted into personal delivery claims.
sh-mohmed-puzi-sh-ali.completion: No comparable, dated numerical completion metric was verified for these selected records; percentages remain NULL.
sh-mohmed-puzi-sh-ali.party_membership: Supported by linked Parliament and party/representative sources.
